subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, and config contract is acceptable?
rationale: The remaining request changes Google Chat credential storage, consent scopes, event subscription lifecycle, and visibility of non-mentioned Space content, which source review can identify but cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Keep Mentioned Webhook Scope
options.body: Limit the bundled Google Chat plugin to service-account webhook delivery and close or narrow all-message ingestion as out of scope while continuing narrow thread-reply fixes.

options.title: Defer To Workspace Auth Architecture
options.body: Hold implementation until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, event-subscription, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events/Pub/Sub contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from recent Google Chat thread-reply history and the security/config product boundary implicated by the remaining work.
